thread:
marie (PM): quick sync — customer asks keep coming for per-feature add-ons (e.g. vector-store exports, realtime routing) instead of pure token tiers. we need a decision: treat as metered add-ons or bake into higher tiers? thoughts?

dmitri (Eng): leaning metered add-ons. cheaper to implement incrementally, can gate via flags. but will add accounting complexity on the runtime side.

joel (Eng): +1 to metered, but need to confirm quota enforcement shape. soft quota vs hard quota matters for runtime fallbacks. soft quota -> degrade to lower-cost model, hard quota -> 429s.

olivia (Revenue Ops): from contracts POV customers want predictable ceilings. metered add-ons are fine if we offer an optional monthly cap. otherwise they push for committed blocks.

sam (Growth): onboarding impact — add-ons increase friction. we should prototype: default simple tiers with 1-2 curated add-ons in UI, advanced customers can enable full metering.

marie (PM): proposal: "metered add-ons with optional soft-cap". launch criteria: 1) UI for enabling add-on + cap, 2) billing events emitted and verifiable, 3) fallback policy defined (what happens when soft-cap reached), 4) doc + sample contract language.

dmitri (Eng): tech checklist I care about: metrics emitted per-request, idempotent billing events, and a cheap enforcement hook in the router. rough snippet for billing event schema:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-1234",
  "addon": "realtime-routing",
  "units": 1,
  "timestamp": "2025-04-20T15:00:00Z"
}
```

olivia (Revenue Ops): need to confirm revenue recognition for metered items. also include a column in contract templates: "addon cap and overage terms". i'll draft sample language.

sam (Growth): KPI to watch for launch: % of trials that enable add-on, conversion delta, and support contacts about confusion. target: <3% support lift.

marie (PM): rollout plan: beta with 3 enterprise customers (ask sales to nominate), public beta in 2w after fixes, GA after 8w and legal signoff. blockers?

joel (Eng): blocker = router hook + low-overhead accounting. estimate 3 sprint points to deliver core enforcement and events.

dmitri (Eng): will need a migration plan for existing dedicated customers that already use bespoke feature flags. add to spec.

pm-bot: created ticket RED-4573: metered-addons MVP and RED-4574: add-on contract template (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-4573).

marie (PM): thanks. next steps: olivia draft contract snippet by EOD Tue, joel+dmitri spike enforcement this week, sam prepare onboarding copy. tagging @dmitri @joel @olivia @sam. :thumbsup:

olivia (Revenue Ops): noted, will share language.

sam (Growth): will prepare short UI copy and a tooltip explaining caps.

joel (Eng): starting spike now, will post findings in thread.

dmitri (Eng): will pair with joel on event schema and router integration.

marie (PM): perfect — we'll reconvene Fri to sign off on launch criteria. thanks everyone! :rocket:
